name: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
So excited I am!

Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!

I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.

Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, adventurer, so I can brew some forest magic!
narrative.objectives: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!
narrative.requestItemsText:
Look at our poor little elf friends. All caged up with no forest to frolic in!

Now were you able to find me some sap? How about the whiskers from the twilight runners? Don't suppose you have that fey dragon scale on you?

And eyes! I'll need so many eyes! You just can't mix up a fierce forest magic brew without a good helping of eyes!
